# OR Block Schedule Redesign

- **Goal / definition of done:** raise **OR block utilization from ~68% to the 75% target** by
  reallocating under-used surgeon blocks and tightening release rules.
- **Owner:** [Robert Tanaka](../people/robert-tanaka.md), Director of Perioperative Services;
  clinical partner [Priya Anand](../people/priya-anand.md) (CMO).
- **Status:** active; in the data-gathering and surgeon-negotiation phase.

## Notes
- Politically sensitive — pulling a block from a high-volume surgeon requires CMO air cover.
- Not on the critical path for ED throughput; a margin and access play.
